name: A Smokywood Pastures' Thank You!
summary: Great-father Winter waits in Orgrimmar to thank those who recovered Smokywood Pastures' stolen holiday treats. Kaymard Copperpinch sends you to receive a token of appreciation for bringing the supplies back.

sections.title: A Corporate Holiday
sections.body: In Orgrimmar, Smokywood Pastures sells treats, recipes, and seasonal cheer for the Feast of Winter Veil. Their shipment was stolen in the snowy hills of the Alterac Mountains, and business stalled. With the treats recovered and the Abominable Greench dealt with, Kaymard Copperpinch sends you to receive the company's thanks.

sections.title: Audience with Great-father Winter
sections.body: Great-father Winter waits beside the holiday tree in the Valley of Strength. The goblins have arranged for him to honor those who rescued the holiday supplies with a seasonal blessing and a Smokywood Pastures Special Gift.

faq.q: Who sends me to speak with Great-father Winter?
faq.answer: Kaymard Copperpinch, Smokywood Pastures' representative in Orgrimmar's Valley of Strength, sends you to Great-father Winter after you recover the company's stolen holiday treats.

faq.q: What did I do to earn Smokywood Pastures' gratitude?
faq.answer: You tracked down the Abominable Greench in the Alterac Mountains and recovered the stolen holiday treats, saving Smokywood Pastures' supplies for the Feast of Winter Veil.

faq.q: Where is Great-father Winter located in Orgrimmar?
faq.answer: Great-father Winter waits beneath the decorated Winter Veil tree in the Valley of Strength, beside the Smokywood Pastures vendor stalls.

Great-father Winter is an elemental or mythic herald of the changing seasons, said to cover the land in winter snow. During the Feast of Winter Veil, mortals wear his red robes to spread goodwill and give treats to children and adventurers.

Smokywood Pastures is a goblin-run culinary and agricultural enterprise. It supplies festive foods, seasonal ingredients, and decorations to the Horde and the Alliance during the Feast of Winter Veil.

faq.q: Do I receive anything else after speaking with him?
faq.answer: Yes. Great-father Winter gives you a Smokywood Pastures Special Gift on the company's behalf, and your efforts earn standing with the Steamwheedle Cartel.

angles.text: In Orgrimmar, the Horde's Winter Veil celebration blends shamanic reverence for the changing seasons with goblin commerce.
As a cook, you can rely on Smokywood Pastures for seasonal supplies, exotic recipes, and festive ingredients eagerly awaited each year.
